MATCH (u:User)-[:VIP]->(s:Stream)
WITH u, COUNT(s) AS streamCount

question: Which 3 people have the smallest age difference between them?

WHERE id(p1) < id(p2) AND id(p2) < id(p3)
WITH p1, p2, p3, 
     abs(p1.born - p2.born) AS diff1, 
     abs(p2.born - p3.born) AS diff2,

WITH p1, p2, p3, (diff1 + diff2 + diff3) AS total_diff
ORDER BY total_diff ASC

WHERE m.year < 1980
RETURN u.userId, u.name
ORDER BY r.timestamp
LIMIT 3

question: What are the top 5 movies with the highest IMDb rating that have been directed by the same director?

question: What are the first 3 movies with a main actor over the age of 50 at the time of filming?

RETURN o.name AS organizationName, ci.name AS cityName, c.name AS countryName

MATCH (o:Organization)-[:HAS_CEO]->(p:Person)
WHERE o.isPublic = true AND o.revenue > 1.0E9
RETURN p.name AS CEO, o.name AS Organization
ORDER BY o.revenue DESC
LIMIT 3

question: Name the first 3 organizations that have a CEO and a board member with different nationalities.
cypher:
MATCH (org:Organization)-[:HAS_CEO]->(ceo:Person),
      (org)-[:HAS_BOARD_MEMBER]->(boardMember:Person),
      (ceo)-[:HAS_PARENT|HAS_CHILD*0..]->(ceoCountry:Country),
      (boardMember)-[:HAS_PARENT|HAS_CHILD*0..]->(boardMemberCountry:Country)
WHERE ceoCountry.name <> boardMemberCountry.name

LIMIT 3

MATCH (u:User {name: 'Will'})-[:WROTE]->(r:Review)-[:REVIEWS]->(b:Business {city: 'Missoula'})
WITH b, count(r) AS reviewCount, collect(r.text) AS reviewTexts
ORDER BY reviewCount DESC
LIMIT 1
RETURN b.name AS businessName, reviewTexts

question: Which 3 products have the most variations in unit price among orders?

ORDER BY productID, unitPrice
WITH productID, productName, COLLECT(unitPrice) AS prices
WITH productID, productName, REDUCE(s = 0, i IN RANGE(1, SIZE(prices) - 1) | s + ABS(TOFLOAT(prices[i]) - TOFLOAT(prices[i-1]))) AS priceVariation
ORDER BY priceVariation DESC
LIMIT 3
RETURN productName, priceVariation
